dedupe_keys.name: data accompanying chapter 3 of the phd dissertation energy system design and operation of hydrogen fuelled ships

description: TU Delft provides MATLAB and Simulink models for retrofitting a diesel cargo ship to a hydrogen fuel-cell and battery-electric configuration. A MATLAB preparation script supplies parameters to Simulink models of a low-pass-filter energy-management strategy. Simulations evaluate several vessel power-demand profiles and generate component power-distribution results. The source describes separate output spreadsheets and plotting material, with MATLAB R2022b and Simulink required. Coverage: No complete measurement interval or evaluation extent is stated in the reviewed source. Access: public native metadata describes the release and its formats. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The bundle accompanies Chapter 3 of the dissertation. Related Chapters 4 and 5 address different optimisation and weather questions. Distribution archives and executable models were not acquired. Real-vessel performance and lifetime-cost accuracy are unverified.
inputs: Vessel power-demand profiles and fuel-cell/battery input parameters.
name: Data accompanying Chapter 3 of the PhD Dissertation: Energy System Design and Operation of Hydrogen Fuelled Ships
notes: Metadata only. No linked files, executable source, dataset arrays, archives, images, instruction documents or external API data were acquired. Native source claims were not independently reproduced.
outputs: Fuel-cell and battery power distribution, degradation assessment and lifetime-cost comparisons.
